subject: Next steps: trial data handoff & evaluation contact plan - GreenByte POC
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: michaela.ortiz@greenbyte.ai, tom.reed@greenbyte.ai
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's discovery (trial data handoff plan)

Hi Michaela / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and a proposed POC data handoff & evaluation plan so we can align on timing and owners. Please review and flag anything missing.

Summary of today
- Goal: 4-week trial to validate answer accuracy and latency for GreenByte's internal support assistant (customer support & billing intents).
- Primary success criteria (draft): 1) >= 85% correctness on a stratified prompt set (support, billing, cancellation), 2) median 95th-percentile latency < 450ms at expected concurrency, 3) no PII leakage on sampled outputs.

What we need from GreenByte (deliverables)
1) Prompt set: 1,200 anonymized support transcripts and 300 billing/cancellation seed prompts. Prefer newline-delimited JSONL with fields: id, prompt_text, metadata.intent, created_at, customer_id_hash. See attachment for schema.
2) Evaluation rubric: the golden answers / expected labels for ~400 sampled prompts (will be used for automated pass/fail and manual review).
3) Transfer method: S3 pre-signed upload or secure SFTP. Reducing friction, we prefer an S3 bucket we provide with a temp upload role.
4) Security notes: confirm whether data must be tokenized/hashed beyond customer_id_hash, any additional redaction requests.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Nov 6: GreenByte to share sample 50-record anonymized sample + confirm upload method
- Nov 9: Redwood ingests sample, returns basic schema validation and anonymization checklist
- Nov 13: Full dataset upload (S3) begins
- Nov 17: Data ingestion & eval pipeline run completed; first metric snapshot shared
- Nov 20: Joint review call to agree pass/fail and next steps

Owners (initial):
- GreenByte: Michaela Ortiz (data owner), Tom Reed (security lead)
- Redwood: Lauren Bishop (trial lead), Rishi Malhotra (evaluation engineer), Stephanie Nguyen (security/ops contact)

Small asks for the sample upload: please include a 50-record sample by COB Nov 6 with one or two examples of billing/cancellation prompts. Mark any records that include sensitive PII we should avoid pulling into manual review queues.

I'll attach a short checklist for S3 transfer and the draft success criteria spreadsheet for your review. If these dates look workable, I'll schedule the intake slot in our calendar for Nov 14 (data ingestion window).

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- greenbyte-poc-success-criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet: success criteria + eval sample mapping)
- s3-transfer-checklist.txt (plain-text transfer steps and IAM role instructions)
From: Michaela Ortiz <michaela.ortiz@greenbyte.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.reed@greenbyte.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 09:38:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery (trial data handoff plan)

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the clear recap. Agree with the success criteria and timeline; a couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Data format: we can produce the prompts as JSONL with the fields you listed. We will replace customer_id with a salted SHA256 hash (we can share the salt via our security channel).
2) PII: we have an automated scrubber but we'll still flag records that may require additional human redaction. We want to exclude full transcripts containing SSNs or payment card numbers from the manual review set; we will mark them with metadata.sensitive = true.
3) Upload: S3 with an upload role is preferred. Can Redwood provide a temporary bucket + upload policy? If not, we can provision an SFTP endpoint.

We'll put together the 50-record sample by COB Monday (Nov 6) and include 5 billing/cancellation prompts. Tom is copied for any security/transfer questions.

Thanks,
Michaela Ortiz
Head of Product Operations
GreenByte AI
michaela.ortiz@greenbyte.ai

Attachment: none
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: michaela.ortiz@greenbyte.ai, tom.reed@greenbyte.ai
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Nov 2028 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery (trial data handoff plan)

Thanks, Michaela — great. Per your preference, Redwood can provision a temporary S3 upload role and bucket. Below are the next actions and contacts from our side: 

Action items (Redwood-created)
- Nov 6 (today): I will create the temporary S3 bucket and pre-signed upload role and send the link + IAM instructions. (owner: lauren.bishop)
- Nov 7: Rishi to run a schema validation script on sample and return a short report. (owner: rishi.malhotra)
- Nov 13-14: Stephanie to coordinate ingestion window and monitor uploads; send intake runbook. (owner: stephanie.nguyen)

Security/handling notes: 
- We will not surface raw prompts containing metadata.sensitive = true to any manual reviewers; those records will be excluded from the manual labeling queue unless GreenByte explicitly approves.
- All data in the temporary bucket will be encrypted at rest; we will rotate the temp credentials after ingestion and provide an audit log link.

Bucket and transfer stub (temporary, do not share):
- s3://redwood-poc-greenbyte-2028-11/upload/
- Pre-signed URL approach: we'll send individual pre-signed PUT URLs for files > 100MB.

Please reply to confirm and then we'll send the S3 instructions off-band (secure email). If you hit any delays putting together the sample, let us know — we can accept a slightly delayed sample but would like to keep ingestion the week of Nov 13.

Best,
Lauren

Attachments:
- s3-transfer-checklist.txt
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: michaela.ortiz@greenbyte.ai, tom.reed@greenbyte.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery (trial data handoff plan)

Quick internal note + CC'ing GreenByte for transparency.

I'll run the sample validator as soon as the 50-record sample lands. A couple technical checks I'll perform:
- Schema conformance (required fields, parseable JSONL)
- Distribution check (intent balance and date ranges)
- Anonymization checks (customer_id_hash format, obvious PII left in prompt_text)

Question for GreenByte: for KV-cache and inference efficiency tests, do you want us to preserve original conversation prefixes (to simulate multi-turn), or do you prefer single-shot prompts only? Preserving prefixes helps validate latency under realistic KV sizes; single-shot is easier to label.

If you have a preference, we can include both splits in the eval pipeline.

Thanks,
Rishi
Evaluation Engineer
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
